name: Phu Quoc pepper
summary: Peppercorns from the island’s inland gardens, aromatic and spicy, with a floral nose and real heat. The same pepper goes into the salt-and-lime dip for Hàm Ninh crab.
taste: Aromatic and spicy on the nature account. A floral aroma and intense heat on the whisper account. Pungent and spicy on the 3-day account. That 3-day account says over 1,000 tons a year.
howToEat: Taste it at a garden in the morning and take a bag home.
At Hàm Ninh, boiled crab comes with muối tiêu chanh, salt and pepper with lime.
seoTitle: Ho tieu Phu Quoc — island pepper
seoDescription: Phu Quoc pepper is aromatic, floral, and hot. Taste it in an inland garden and in the salt-and-lime dip for Hàm Ninh crab.
